notes:
- Browse a whole folder of PDFs without opening them. Pick a folder (File menu
  or the toolbar) and step through every PDF in it with the arrow keys, see each
  one's pages, file details and document info side by side, open the one you want,
  or move a file straight to the Trash.
- Crash recovery. If Tumbler closes with edits you never saved, the next launch
  offers to bring them back. Your original file is never touched: recovery works
  from a private snapshot kept only while a document has unsaved changes, and it
  is cleared the moment you save or discard.
- New option to open each PDF in its own window instead of a tab. Find it under
  Settings, Documents.
- Refreshed the Settings window so everything is grouped and easier to scan.
